using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Execution;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Tests.Execution;

public class FlowExecutorTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task ExecuteFlowAsync_LogsExitingLoopInformation_WhenStepResultHasExitLoopResponse()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<FlowExecutor>>();
        loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);

        var kernelBuilderMock = new Mock<IKernelBuilder>();
        var statusProviderMock = new Mock<IFlowStatusProvider>();
        var globalPlugins = new Dictionary<object, string?>();

        var flowMock = new Mock<Flow>();
        flowMock.Setup(f => f.SortSteps()).Returns(new List<FlowStep> { new Mock<FlowStep>().Object });
        flowMock.Setup(f => f.Name).Returns("TestFlow");

        var stepMock = new Mock<FlowStep>();
        stepMock.Setup(s => s.Goal).Returns("TestGoal");
        stepMock.Setup(s => s.Provides).Returns(new[] { "var1" });

        var executionStateMock = new Mock<ExecutionState>();
        executionStateMock.Setup(e => e.CurrentStepIndex).Returns(0);
        executionStateMock.Setup(e => e.StepStates).Returns(new Dictionary<string, ExecutionState.StepExecutionState>());
        executionStateMock.SetupProperty(e => e.Variables);

        statusProviderMock.Setup(s => s.GetExecutionStateAsync(It.IsAny<string>()))
            .ReturnsAsync(executionStateMock.Object);

        var flowExecutor = new FlowExecutor(kernelBuilderMock.Object, statusProviderMock.Object, globalPlugins)
        {
            _logger = loggerMock.Object
        };

        var stepResultMock = new Mock<FunctionResult>();
        stepResultMock.Setup(r => r.TryGetExitLoopResponse(out It.IsAny<string?>())).Returns(true);
        stepResultMock.Setup(r => r.Metadata).Returns(new Dictionary<string, object> { { "var1", "value1" } }.ToImmutableDictionary());

        // Use reflection to set private fields for testing the specific logging path
        typeof(FlowExecutor).GetField("_reActEngine", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!
            .SetValue(flowExecutor, new Mock<ReActEngine>(new Mock<Kernel>().Object, loggerMock.Object, new FlowOrchestratorConfig()).Object);

        // Act
        var kernelArgs = new KernelArguments();
        await flowExecutor.ExecuteFlowAsync(flowMock.Object, "test-session", "input", kernelArgs);

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.LogInformation(
                "Exiting loop for step {StepIndex} with iteration={Iteration}, goal={StepGoal}.",
                0,
                It.IsAny<int>(),
                "TestGoal"),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_CreatesLoggerAndLogsNothing()
    {
        // Arrange & Act
        var kernelBuilderMock = new Mock<IKernelBuilder>();
        var kernelMock = new Mock<Kernel>();
        kernelMock.Setup(k => k.LoggerFactory).Returns(new Mock<ILoggerFactory>().Object);
        kernelBuilderMock.Setup(b => b.Build()).Returns(kernelMock.Object);

        var statusProviderMock = new Mock<IFlowStatusProvider>();
        var globalPlugins = new Dictionary<object, string?>();

        // Act
        var flowExecutor = new FlowExecutor(kernelBuilderMock.Object, statusProviderMock.Object, globalPlugins);

        // Assert - Constructor doesn't log the specific message, just verifies logger creation
        Assert.NotNull(flowExecutor);
    }
}

            StepStates = new Dictionary<string, ExecutionState.StepExecutionState>(),

        };
    }

    private static FlowStep CreateMockFlowStep(string goal, string[] provides)
    {
        var stepMock = new Mock<FlowStep>();
        stepMock.Setup(s => s.Goal).Returns(goal);
        stepMock.Setup(s => s.Provides).Returns(provides);
        return stepMock.Object;
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Abstractions;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Tests.Execution;

public class FlowExecutorLoggerTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void LoggerExtensions_LogInformation_IsCalled_WhenExitingLoop()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);

        // Create FlowExecutor with our logger (using reflection to set private field)
        var kernelBuilderMock = new Mock<IKernelBuilder>();
        kernelBuilderMock.Setup(b => b.Build()).Returns(CreateMockKernel(loggerMock.Object));
        
        var statusProviderMock = new Mock<IFlowStatusProvider>();
        var globalPlugins = new Dictionary<object, string?>();
        
        var flowExecutor = new FlowExecutor(kernelBuilderMock.Object, statusProviderMock.Object, globalPlugins);
        
        // Use reflection to inject our test logger
        var loggerField = typeof(FlowExecutor).GetField("_logger", 
            System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        loggerField.SetValue(flowExecutor, loggerMock.Object);

        // Act - Directly test the logging extension method pattern by verifying the underlying Log call
        loggerMock.Object.LogInformation("Exiting loop for step {StepIndex} with iteration={Iteration}, goal={StepGoal}.", 0, 1, "test-goal");

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ((IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<string, object>>)v).Any(kvp => kvp.Key == "StepIndex" && kvp.Value.ToString() == "0")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LoggerExtensions_LogInformation_IsCalled_WhenContinuingLoop()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);

        // Act
        loggerMock.Object.LogInformation("Continuing to the next loop iteration for step {StepIndex} with iteration={Iteration}, goal={StepGoal}.", 0, 1, "test-goal");

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ((IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<string, object>>)v).Any(kvp => kvp.Key == "StepIndex" && kvp.Value.ToString() == "0")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LoggerExtensions_LogInformation_Respects_IsEnabledCheck()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(false);

        // Act & Assert - No exception thrown, no Log call made
        loggerMock.Object.LogInformation("Test message {Param}", "value");
        
        loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(It.IsAny<LogLevel>(), It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()), Times.Never);
    }

    private static Kernel CreateMockKernel(ILogger logger)
    {
        var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
        loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<Type>())).Returns(logger);
        var kernelMock = new Mock<Kernel>();
        kernelMock.Setup(k => k.LoggerFactory).Returns(loggerFactoryMock.Object);
        return kernelMock.Object;
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Experimental.Orchestration.Tests.Execution;

public class LoggerExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void LogInformation_LogsMessage_WhenIsEnabledReturnsTrue()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);

        // Act
        loggerMock.Object.LogInformation("Exiting loop for step {StepIndex} with iteration={Iteration}, goal={StepGoal}.", 0, 1, "test-goal");

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ((IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<string, object>>)v).Any(kvp => kvp.Key == "StepIndex")),
                null!,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogInformation_DoesNotLog_WhenIsEnabledReturnsFalse()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(false);

        // Act
        loggerMock.Object.LogInformation("Continuing to the next loop iteration for step {StepIndex} with iteration={Iteration}, goal={StepGoal}.", 0, 1, "test-goal");

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                It.IsAny<LogLevel>(),
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogInformation_HandlesMultipleParameters_Correctly()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);

        // Act
        loggerMock.Object.LogInformation("Exiting loop for step {StepIndex} with iteration={Iteration}, goal={StepGoal}.", 42, 7, "achieve goal");

        // Assert - Verify structured logging with all parameters
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => 
                {
                    var state = (IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<string, object>>)v;
                    return state.Any(kvp => kvp.Key == "StepIndex" && kvp.Value.ToString() == "42") &&
                           state.Any(kvp => kvp.Key == "Iteration" && kvp.Value.ToString() == "7") &&
                           state.Any(kvp => kvp.Key == "StepGoal" && kvp.Value.ToString() == "achieve goal");
                }),
                null!,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogInformation_NullLogger_HandlesGracefully()
    {
        // Arrange
        var nullLogger = NullLogger.Instance;

        // Act & Assert - No exception thrown
        nullLogger.LogInformation("Test message with {Param}", "value");
    }
}
